notes: OADC official Parklands (JNB3) page confirms carrier-neutral colocation at 17 Walters St, Rosebank, Johannesburg (City of Johannesburg); OADC LinkedIn announced JNB3 launch (2026). Vertiv official release (2026-05-29) confirms OADC standardised power/cooling at Parklands for high-density scalable growth; OADC datasheet (Jan 2026) gives ~3,300 sqm.
